physical_scope: Prescribed kinematics; not force, stress or mantle evolution

input_units.time: forward SI s in a named epoch

temporal_policy: Explicit frozen-at-start spatial prescription for the exact requested interval, not exact moving-topology evolution

reductions.planar-columns: Relative rigid angular rate zero; relative translation along section, no transverse/vertical flux
reductions.great-circle-columns: Relative Euler vector parallel to great-circle pole; volume/(reference arc length * explicit reference_width_m), not raw radial thickness

ownership: Preserve every inclusive owner row; no averaging discontinuous velocities; continuous-section interface checks refuse discontinuities even between grid faces
boundary_conditions: No zeroing prescribed face velocities; caller supplies required exterior material
outputs: All-owner diagnostic components or checked RegionalGrid1D N+1 face velocities, with source/frame/epoch/interval/reduction identity
verification: Independent synthetic kinematics, seam/refusal/covariance, unchanged geology, grid/order reuse, source/store checks and one three-cell regional transport witness
